records.stdout:
Usage: lcc [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...                                                                                 
                                                                                                                        
 Local Context Compiler (lcc): deterministic, local-first context optimization for LLM prompts.                         
                                                                                                                        
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --version          Show the version and exit.                                                                        │
│ --help             Show this message and exit.                                                                       │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Commands ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ optimize            Clean, deduplicate, and structure INPUT into an optimized prompt and JSON report.                │
│ prepare             Inspect INPUT first, then generate a prompt only when safe optimization is useful.               │
│ bench               Report mechanical optimization and prepare-selection metrics for benchmark cases.                │
│ semantic-retrieval  Report the Phase 2 semantic retrieval boundary status; no retrieval is performed.                │
│ inspect             Analyze INPUT and emit a deterministic diagnostic report -- no prompt is generated.              │
│ diff                Compare two text files: sizes, token deltas, and a unified diff — offline.                       │
│ compact             Drop context blocks irrelevant to OBJECTIVE (opt-in narrow model judgment; fails safe).          │
│ explain             Explain a compaction report: why each block was kept, trimmed or dropped.                        │
│ intake              Analyze raw, unstructured, or voice prompt input, structure intent, and compile with LCC.        │
│ agent               Manage and execute local LLM agents (Gemma 4 e4b, Qwen3.5-4B).                                   │
│ route               Hybrid local/cloud context routing and evaluation.                                               │
│ mcp                 Run the MCP (Model Context Protocol) server (see docs/MCP.md).                                   │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
